biocontainers.name: bioconductor-multigsea
biocontainers.summary: Extracted features from pathways derived from 8 different databases (KEGG, Reactome, Biocarta, etc.) can be used on transcriptomic, proteomic, and/or metabolomic level to calculate a combined GSEA-based enrichment score.
